annotations.title: But not iustified.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Heretikes are certaine that they be in Gods grace, but S. Paul though guiltie of no crime in his conscience, durst not assure him self that he was iustified, neither could take vpon him to be iudge of his owne hart and cogitations, whether they were pure or no: but the trial thereof he left onely to Gods iudging day.

notes.text: No man sure of grace or iustification.

annotations.title: In rodde.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> The Apostles haue power of discipline and censures against offenders, and power of gentlenes, meekenes, and indulgence also: to vse either punishing or pardoning, according to their wisedom, and according to the occasions of time and place.

notes.text: Spiritual power to punish or pardon.
